source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Hole order worked out from the photos and the card's pars and lengths only; no hole numbers were visible and the map's greens are unnumbered, so the numbering may be wrong.
unsure.1: Several small tee pads near the clubhouse; which one is the 1st tee is a guess.
unsure.9: Green taken as the round green beside the clubhouse; it could be the practice putting green.
unsure.11: The area south of the north fairways has several small greens and pads (may partly be a practice area); this par 3's tee and green are a guess.
unsure.13: Holes 13 and 14 share one wide fairway in opposite directions; which way each plays is a guess.
unsure.14: Green taken as a small round green at the south end of the shared fairway; it could be a tee.
unsure.15: No back tee seen; traced shorter than the card. Tee placed at the start of the fairway.
unsure.16: Tee and green picked among small greens and pads near the north practice area; a guess.
unsure.18: Green on the peninsula by the clubhouse, tee on the walled tee box across the pond; the 9th and 18th both being par 3s here makes which is which uncertain.
